name: OSK
recent: OSK Holdings Berhad 近期在澳洲墨尔本启动 A$800m AURA 塔楼建设，并通过 OSK Property 以 RM200m 的 OSK Sora 项目进入 Rawang 市场。公司也进行了品牌更新，将三个部门统一以 CID 品牌呈现。最新季度（截至2026年6月30日）营收环比增长29.5%，但净利率从31.8%降至25.5%。
notable: OSK Property 以 RM200m 的 OSK Sora 项目进入 Rawang 市场，并开放意向登记。
OSK Property 在墨尔本启动 A$800m AURA 塔楼建设。
公司进行品牌更新，三个部门统一以 CID 品牌呈现。
risks: 执行主席 Tan Sri Ong Leong Huat 在2026年10月多次间接增持公司股份。
集团董事总经理 Ong Ju Yan 在2026年10月多次直接增持公司股份。
最新季度净利率从上一季度的31.8%下降至25.5%。
earnings: 截至2026年6月30日的季度，营收为 MYR563.1m，环比增长29.5%，同比增长10.3%；净利为 MYR143.4m，环比增长3.9%，同比增长1.0%；净利率为25.5%，低于上一季度的31.8%。

recent_en: OSK Holdings Berhad recently commenced construction of the A$800m AURA tower in Melbourne, Australia, and entered the Rawang market via OSK Property's RM200m OSK Sora project. The company also completed a brand refresh, unifying three divisions under the CID brand. In the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue rose 29.5% QoQ, while net margin declined from 31.8% to 25.5%.
notable_en: OSK Property entered the Rawang market with the RM200m OSK Sora project and opened registration of interest.
OSK Property commenced construction of the A$800m AURA tower in Melbourne.
The company completed a brand refresh, unifying three divisions under the CID brand.
risks_en: Executive Chairman Tan Sri Ong Leong Huat acquired indirect interests in the company multiple times in October 2026.
Group Managing Director Ong Ju Yan acquired direct interests in the company multiple times in October 2026.
Net margin declined to 25.5% in the latest quarter from 31.8% in the previous quarter.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR563.1m, up 29.5% QoQ and 10.3% YoY; net income was MYR143.4m, up 3.9% QoQ and 1.0% YoY; net margin was 25.5%, down from 31.8% in the previous quarter.
